scientific_integrity: The original construction and unaveraged Lyapunov cluster intervals are credited to Nakano, Soma and Yamamoto. The present derived claim concerns the second averaging, its exact extremal interval and logarithmic mean; these are proved from the source derivative-block identity.
scientific_limitations: Applies to coordinate vectors and almost all points in the specified wandering rectangle, not arbitrary vectors or invariant-measure typical points. Publication priority beyond inspected sources remains subject to independent checking.
source_ids: Tsujii, Piecewise expanding maps ... singular ergodic properties (1998, supporting)
